name: understory-vscode
description: Investigate why a line of code is the way it is, from your editor.

commands.title: Understory: Open Full Investigation on the Web

enumDescriptions: Run the investigation in-process against the local git repo — no server needed.
Send the request to a running backend at backendUrl (for remote GitHub/GitLab repos).
understory.mode.markdownDescription: How investigations run. `local` collects and synthesizes in-process (needs a Groq API key set via the *Set Groq API Key* command). `backend` calls `{backendUrl}/api/dig`.

understory.backendUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the Understory backend, used when `understory.mode` is `backend`. The extension calls `{backendUrl}/api/dig`.

understory.webUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the hosted Understory web app, opened by *Open Full Investigation on the Web*. Point this at the deployment where you are signed in, so private-repo investigations use your session. The extension opens `{webUrl}/app?repo=…&file=…&line=…`, where the full GitHub/GitLab provenance (PRs, reviews, issues) is collected.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run compile
